verdict.rationale: Superhuman's documentation in the pack never claims to block senders' tracking pixels or explain how it handles mail data, so there is no vendor claim to dispute. The one on-topic community item points the other way: it says Superhuman does not let its customers turn images off, leaving them exposed to pixel tracking. With no documented tracking protection and no data-transparency evidence, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a switcher, the client protects me from senders' tracking — blocking read pixels by default — and is transparent about what it does with my mail data
